header: Is the request from this site's own pages? A browser sends Origin on a cross-site POST; the site's own pages send the same host as the request's Host. I let a request with no Origin (a script, the same page in some cases) pass: the session cookie is SameSite=Lax, which already keeps another site's form from carrying it. Pure.
